title: Kreegan Alliance - Raw Translation
description: Parallel Kreegan Alliance emit-only raw_translation map (same pipeline class as Homecoming). Runtime gameplay remains user-unvalidated.

inputs.templateMap: V:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Heroes of Might and Magic Olden Era - Golden Era\HeroesOldenEra_Data\StreamingAssets\maps\Thirst_for_Power.map

knownGaps: Raw translation is the only campaign map generation lane; the StoryHub continuity installer ships this SID. Layered-atlas, approach-cell, zone-atlas and single-layer lanes are retired.
emit_fresh core overlay for every mission; no lane inherits another lane's overlay.
Emit-only: land-on GATE clones, HoMM3 block-mask solid-square mountain/tree sizing, and BR-to-Olden multi-tile node shift are the only placement transforms.

Forbidden: block parity pads, accessibility repair, mountain merge, local approach-cell clears, spawn unbury, sign omit-as-policy, stray-water GATE clears, boat/decoration extras, functional emit scenery omit, exact-anchor scenery suppress, UG scenery suppress, footprint_alignment, functional_points.

UG tunnel clearance ON when underground layers exist (chebyshev_two_tile_elevation_shoulder_rock_to_burrow_clearance): H3 rock projects as levelsMap=1 cliffs, so thin corridors would lose 2x2 clearance without the shoulder. Runtime UG traversal remains user-unvalidated.
Gate-face mirror rotation ON for eligible single-GATE footprints.
Occupied stacks and buried visits are intentional diagnostics of honest 1:1 translation; they are not fail-closed contract failures.
Signs keep source placements when substitution emits them; no fx_quest_mark_* omit policy.

Hero hire: HoMM3-authentic multi-hero (heroCountMin=1, heroCountMax=8). Per-mission H3M levelLimit drives enableCustomHeroMaxLevel/customHeroMaxLevel (0 = unlimited). Cities keep default_buildings_ban so tavern is not banned.
Per-placement three-way ground truth is emitted as <missionId>.raw_translation_placement_ground_truth.json (HoMM3 object + substitution mapping + Olden sid/node/occupied).
Underground HoMM3 ocean terrain is converted to walkable Burrow land with pond scenery (pool_dirt_small_1 / pool_dirt_big_1) unless terrain.preserveUndergroundOcean is set.
Runtime clickability, pathing, and hole-free playtest remain user-unvalidated.
runtimeScriptComment: kreegan_alliance raw-translation runtime script generated from campaign alignment story.
